comments.author: Jean
comments.body: Well, this site is great for asking questions as the comments form is left open to those not logged in. An asked question that receives an answer is a contribution to the UWO community. I being a noob and only human have asked many dumb questions to which most have had helpful replies. I in turn have answered and added to as many questions as I can. Because of all of us doing the same this site has become a great resource for a great game that is quite involved but lacks English documentation which would otherwise create a barrier to newer players if not for us all sharing what we have learned along the way.
